why_already_public.text: Welcome — this is about Public Disclosure of Astellas CCI: what's already public, and what it means for you. Here is the starting point: packages can contain company secrets and/or participant and personnel PI/PPD. So how do you know what's confidential? You classify with GUIDE-AST-6011, and you document on FORM-AST-35734 — the asset-specific library. And here is something worth pausing on: already public is not confidential. Check the public domain — if it's already out there, it is not CCI.

guide_classify.text: So how do you classify? GUIDE-AST-6011 is your tool — CCI, may-be-CCI, or not-CCI, including phase. And phase matters: standards apply at all phases, but the sensitivity decreases later and after marketing authorization. Here is how the GUIDE breaks it down. CMC: may-be-CCI includes drug-substance names and structure early, quantitative composition, metabolite formulae and pathways that reveal manufacture, polymorphism and sequence, impurities, manufacturing methods, sites, CMOs, specs, batch size, unpublished in-house cells, drug-product packaging technical specs, and AAV fact of synthesis or formulation change. Not-CCI: published or commercial cell-line names, general characterization, excipient names, standard storage, batch numbers, common techniques, and fact of process change except AAV. Nonclinical: may-be-CCI includes unpublished novel mechanism-of-action concepts, metabolites until NDA/BLA, special substrate, exclusive assays, early results, CRO and site names, future plans, study dates, detailed HA advice, and contractual strategy. Not-CCI: ELISA, Biacore, and common assays, published techniques, and country names. Clinical: may-be-CCI includes unpublished patentable unit, daily, or maximum dose — novel unqualified biomarkers, exclusive assays, non-label endpoints, and third-party questionnaires when a contract forbids disclosure. Not-CCI: route, frequency, and setting; design; results; CRO names; and fact of HA consult. Other: may-be-CCI includes exposure calculations, exposure and sales by country, projected exposure, product cost, and net pricing. Not-CCI: list pricing.

form_as_object.text: Now, once you have classified, where does it go? FORM-AST-35734 — the CCI library. Think of it as your asset's living record. The cover captures your version date, the asset code or INN — that is the ASPXXXX identifier — the Project ID in Helix, and the development phase. Inside, the library is organized by columns: type, subtype, CCI exact text, and notes. And one practical rule: one tab per phase. That is how each phase gets its own clean workspace in the FORM.

asset_lead_path.text: Here is the path when a compound moves from CN to IND. The PD Lead initiates. Then the Asset Lead classifies with the GUIDE — and may consult an SME, a Dept Head, or Legal. Next: document on the FORM. Then inform the PD Lead. Archive. And finally, inform the Disclosing Parties. That is the path — from initiation to notification.

discloser_path.text: And what about the person doing the disclosing? Procedure D: follow the FORM or escalate before you ship. When you prepare and post, you work without FORM CCI — that is the rule. And if there is a deviation, contact the Asset Lead and the PD Lead via publicdisclosure-sm@astellas.com before you ship. That contact is your escalation path.

lesson_end.text: Before you go, a few questions — just making sure the key ideas landed. Take your time. And then: you're informed. You know what's already public and what it means for you — and that knowledge is yours to use.
